name: @playliquid/runtime-core
description: PlayLiquid GameOS Interactive Runtime core (PL-013). The interactive runtime session kernel: the Experience Protocol surface (load, reset, observe, act, step, snapshot, restore, replay seam, terminate) implemented over @playliquid/runtime-contracts as the single canonical command/event path (E2, lock 12), with the CapabilityPort seam to the Capability Broker (lock 4; broker itself is PL-026), injected host-side ports (renderer surface, input source, transport, snapshot store, clock) and in-memory fakes for tests. Pure kernel logic: no IO, no timers, no engine SDKs, no rendering/input/networking implementations — those are host adapters.
